title: Phase 1 Consolidation — ARCHIVE-STALE: Archive stale and superseded projects
spec:
CONSOLIDATION ACTION: ARCHIVE-STALE

Archive projects that are no longer active and have been superseded.

TASK 1: Inventory stale projects
Check these locations in the master folder and report what exists:
- _archived/python-empty/ (may already be archived from migration)
- Any empty directories under _archived/ that are just shells

TASK 2: Archive remaining stale items
Move the following to _archived/ if not already there:
- Any empty project directories (Email App, Asana shells, etc.)
- Check if there are any Cursor-only exploration artifacts (.cursor/Outlook Agent or similar)

TASK 3: Do NOT archive these (they have active value):
- data/blue-shield/ (has SHI analysis — keep for reference)
- data/digitized-delivery-ges/ (active data, Airtable tracking)
- Any project marked ACTIVE in MASTER_INDEX.md

TASK 4: Clean up _archived/
- Ensure _archived/ARCHIVE_LOG.md exists (may have been created during EMAIL-CONSOLIDATE)
- Append entries for anything newly archived with timestamp and reason
- Verify each archived project has its README intact

TASK 5: Security audit on archived projects
- Run: grep -r "AKIA\\|sk_live\\|ghp_\\|pat[A-Z]\\|Bearer " in each archived project
- If any credentials found, redact them and report to Windsurf
- Verify no .env files contain real credentials

TASK 6: Update MASTER_INDEX.md
- Mark any newly archived projects as ARCHIVED
- Verify all project statuses are accurate

CONSTRAINTS:
- Move only — never delete
- Append to ARCHIVE_LOG.md, don't overwrite
